items.headline: Browns QB Watson cited for speeding in August, pleads not guilty
items.description: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson entered a not guilty plea after being cited for allegedly driving 86 mph in a 60 mph zone on Aug. 26.

items.headline: NFL Week 1 uniforms: Vikings rocking throwbacks, Bengals go orange
items.description: The NFL is back, and so are the uniform combinations. Here's a look at what each team is wearing in Week 1.

items.headline: Browns' Deshaun Watson set for first start since 2024 season
items.description: Browns QB Deshaun Watson, who is making his first regular-season start since October 2024, said he has an opportunity to "showcase that I can still play in this league."

items.headline: One thing Deshaun Watson has to improve to remain Browns' starter
items.description: Whether the veteran passer can regain dominance over this particular skill will help determine his role in 2026.

items.headline: Todd Monken, QBs, the Browns and a lifetime in pursuit
items.description: At age 60, the first-time head coach brings to Cleveland a gritty resolve, an ability to cut through to QBs and a dream that this will be "my last job."

items.headline: Browns may have package of plays for rookie QB Green, Monken says
items.description: Browns coach Todd Monken said Monday that rookie quarterback Taylen Green could have a package of plays on game day to utilize his athleticism.
